prompt_zh: 多買十部衣車、多請二十個工人係 external expansion，因為間 firm 大咗。
hint_en: Does getting bigger always mean the firm has combined with another firm?
hint_zh: 變大咗係咪一定代表同第二間 firm 結合咗？
explain_en: External expansion must involve combining with another firm through a merger or an acquisition. Adding machines and workers is the firm growing on its own, so it is internal expansion.
explain_zh: External expansion 一定要透過 merger 或者 acquisition 同第二間 firm 結合。加機器同請人係 firm 自己長大，所以係 internal expansion。

prompt_en: A firm that buys enough shares of another firm to take control of it is carrying out internal expansion, because it pays with its own money.
prompt_zh: 一間 firm 買夠另一間 firm 嘅股份去控制佢，因為用自己嘅錢，所以算 internal expansion。
hint_en: Does paying with its own money change the fact that a second firm is involved?
hint_zh: 用自己嘅錢畀錢，會唔會改變咗有第二間 firm 參與呢個事實？
explain_en: The criterion is whether another firm is combined with, not where the money comes from. Taking control of another firm by buying its shares is an acquisition, a form of external expansion.
explain_zh: 準則係有冇同另一間 firm 結合，唔係啲錢邊度嚟。買股份控制另一間 firm 就係 acquisition，屬於 external expansion。

prompt_en: Which of the following is an example of external expansion?
prompt_zh: 以下邊個係 external expansion 嘅例子？
options_en: A workshop opens a third branch in Kwun Tong.|A factory uses its retained profit to buy two more machines.|A toy firm takes over a rival toy firm by buying most of its shares.|A trading firm sends salesmen to develop a new market.
options_zh: 一間工場喺觀塘開第三間分店。|一間工廠用留存利潤買多兩部機器。|一間玩具 firm 買起對手大部分股份，接管咗佢。|一間貿易 firm 派銷售員去開拓新市場。
hint_en: In which case does a second firm become part of the expanding firm?
hint_zh: 邊個情況有第二間 firm 變成擴充中嗰間 firm 嘅一部分？
explain_en: External expansion means combining with another firm by a merger or an acquisition. Branches, machines and new markets are the firm growing by itself, so they are internal expansion.
explain_zh: External expansion 即係透過 merger 或 acquisition 同另一間 firm 結合。開分店、買機器、開拓新市場都係 firm 自己長大，屬於 internal expansion。

prompt_en: Internal expansion refers to a firm that:
prompt_zh: Internal expansion 係指一間 firm：
options_en: combines with another firm to form a single firm|takes over another firm by buying its shares|is taken over by a larger firm|expands its own operation without combining with another firm
options_zh: 同另一間 firm 結合成一間 firm|買股份接管另一間 firm|被一間大啲嘅 firm 接管|冇同其他 firm 結合，自己擴大經營
hint_en: What is the key word that tells internal from external expansion?
hint_zh: 分辨 internal 同 external expansion 嘅關鍵字係乜？
explain_en: The criterion is whether another firm is involved. Internal expansion: the firm expands its own operation alone. External expansion: it combines with another firm.
explain_zh: 準則係有冇第二間 firm 參與。Internal expansion：firm 自己擴大經營。External expansion：同另一間 firm 結合。

prompt_en: Two container trucking firms of similar size agree to combine, and afterwards only one firm exists. This is:
prompt_zh: 兩間規模相若嘅貨櫃車 firm 同意結合，之後只剩低一間 firm。呢個係：
options_en: a merger|an acquisition|internal expansion|opening a branch
options_zh: merger|acquisition|internal expansion|開分店
hint_en: Did one firm take over the other, or did both become one new firm?
hint_zh: 係一間接管另一間，定係兩間變成一間？
explain_en: A merger is two or more firms combining into one firm. An acquisition is one firm taking over another, with the acquiring firm still in control.
explain_zh: Merger 係兩間或以上 firm 結合成一間 firm。Acquisition 係一間 firm 接管另一間，收購方仍然掌控。

prompt_en: Which of the following is NOT external expansion?
prompt_zh: 以下邊個唔係 external expansion？
options_en: A bakery firm merges with another bakery firm.|A bakery firm opens five new shops of its own.|A bakery firm buys 70 per cent of the shares of a cake shop firm.|A bakery firm takes over a flour mill firm.
options_zh: 一間麵包 firm 同另一間麵包 firm 合併。|一間麵包 firm 自己開五間新舖。|一間麵包 firm 買咗一間蛋糕舖 firm 七成股份。|一間麵包 firm 接管咗一間麵粉廠 firm。
hint_en: Which option does not bring a second firm into the group?
hint_zh: 邊個選項冇令第二間 firm 加入呢個集團？
explain_en: Opening its own shops is the firm expanding by itself, so it is internal expansion. The other three all involve a merger or an acquisition of another firm.
explain_zh: 自己開舖係 firm 靠自己擴充，屬於 internal expansion。其餘三個都涉及 merger 或者收購另一間 firm。

prompt_en: Expanding by opening the firm's own new branches is ____ expansion, while combining with another firm is ____ expansion.
prompt_zh: 靠自己開新分店去擴充係 ① expansion，同另一間 firm 結合就係 ② expansion。
options_en: internal|external|horizontal|vertical
options_zh: internal|external|horizontal|vertical
hint_en: Is a second firm involved in each case?
hint_zh: 每個情況有冇第二間 firm 參與？
explain_en: Internal expansion: the firm expands its own operation alone. External expansion: it combines with another firm by a merger or an acquisition.
explain_zh: Internal expansion：firm 自己擴大經營。External expansion：透過 merger 或 acquisition 同另一間 firm 結合。

prompt_en: When two firms combine and only one firm remains, it is a ____. When one firm takes over another firm, it is an ____.
prompt_zh: 兩間 firm 結合、最後只剩一間，呢個係 ①。一間 firm 接管另一間 firm，呢個係 ②。
options_en: merger|acquisition|branch|partnership
options_zh: merger|acquisition|分店|partnership
hint_en: Do the two firms become equals in one firm, or does one firm swallow the other?
hint_zh: 兩間 firm 係平等咁合成一間，定係一間食咗另一間？
explain_en: Merger: two or more firms combine into a single firm. Acquisition: one firm takes over another and controls it.
explain_zh: Merger：兩間或以上 firm 結合成一間 firm。Acquisition：一間 firm 接管並控制另一間。

prompt_en: Sort each way of expanding in the 1980s Kwun Tong industrial district:
prompt_zh: 將 1980 年代觀塘工業區入面每種擴充方法分類：
options_en: internal expansion|external expansion
options_zh: internal expansion|external expansion
items_en: A plastics workshop rents one more floor in the same factory building and installs new moulding machines.|An electronics firm merges with a firm making the same radios.|A metal workshop sends a salesman to look for buyers in a new overseas market.|A garment firm buys a controlling block of shares in a dyeing factory.|A printing firm opens a second workshop of its own near the ferry pier.
items_zh: 一間塑膠工場喺同一幢工廠大廈多租一層，裝多幾部啤機。|一間電子 firm 同一間做同款收音機嘅 firm 合併。|一間五金工場派銷售員去一個新海外市場搵買家。|一間製衣 firm 買咗一間染廠嘅控股股份。|一間印刷 firm 喺碼頭附近自己開第二間工場。
hint_en: Ask each time: is a second firm being combined with, or not?
hint_zh: 每次問一問：有冇同第二間 firm 結合？
explain_en: Internal expansion is growth carried out by the firm alone (extra floors, machines, branches, new markets). External expansion always involves another firm through a merger or an acquisition.
explain_zh: Internal expansion 係 firm 自己做嘅增長（加樓層、加機器、開分店、開新市場）。External expansion 一定涉及另一間 firm，透過 merger 或 acquisition。

prompt_en: Sort each case of external expansion:
prompt_zh: 將以下每個 external expansion 個案分類：
options_en: merger|acquisition
options_zh: merger|acquisition
items_en: Two shipping firms of similar size combine and a single firm is formed.|A large chain buys 80 per cent of the shares of a small chain and controls it.|A firm takes over a weaker rival, and the rival becomes part of the buyer's group.|Three small workshops agree to combine into one new firm.
items_zh: 兩間規模相若嘅船務 firm 結合，變成一間 firm。|一間大連鎖店買咗一間細連鎖店八成股份並控制佢。|一間 firm 接管咗一個較弱嘅對手，對手成為買方集團嘅一部分。|三間細工場同意結合成一間新 firm。
hint_en: Does one side clearly take control of the other?
hint_zh: 係咪有一方明顯取得咗另一方嘅控制權？
explain_en: A merger combines firms into one firm. An acquisition is a takeover: one firm gains control of the other, usually by buying its shares.
explain_zh: Merger 係將幾間 firm 結合成一間。Acquisition 係接管：一間 firm 取得另一間嘅控制權，通常靠買股份。

prompt_en: Put the steps of a workshop's internal expansion in order:
prompt_zh: 將一間工場 internal expansion 嘅步驟排好次序：
items_en: The workshop earns a profit and keeps part of it in the business.|It uses the retained profit to buy more machines and rent one more floor.|It hires more workers and opens a branch of its own.|The firm's own scale of operation is larger, with no other firm involved.
items_zh: 工場賺到利潤，留返一部分喺盤生意度。|佢用留存利潤買多啲機器、多租一層。|佢請多啲工人，自己開多一間分店。|Firm 自己嘅經營規模大咗，全程冇其他 firm 參與。
hint_en: Where does the money for expanding on its own come from first?
hint_zh: 自己擴充嘅錢，最先由邊度嚟？
explain_en: Internal expansion is financed and carried out by the firm itself: profit is retained, more capital and labour are put in, and the firm's own operation grows without any merger or acquisition.
explain_zh: Internal expansion 由 firm 自己出錢同自己做：留存利潤、投入多啲 capital 同 labour，自己盤生意大咗，唔涉及任何 merger 或 acquisition。

prompt_en: (Fictional) In 1983, Mr Cheung's Ngai Kee Metal Works rents one floor in a Kwun Tong factory building. Business is good, so he rents the floor above, buys six more lathes and hires fifteen workers. Ngai Kee has carried out:
prompt_zh: （虛構）1983 年，張生嘅毅記五金喺觀塘一幢工廠大廈租咗一層。生意好，佢再租埋樓上一層，買多六部車床，請多十五個工人。毅記做咗：
options_en: external expansion, because it is now much bigger|internal expansion, because it expanded its own operation with no other firm involved|a merger with the landlord|an acquisition of the upper floor firm
options_zh: external expansion，因為佢而家大好多|internal expansion，因為佢冇其他 firm 參與，自己擴大經營|同業主合併|收購咗樓上嗰間 firm
hint_en: Did Ngai Kee combine with any other firm?
hint_zh: 毅記有冇同任何其他 firm 結合過？
explain_en: Renting more space, buying machines and hiring workers are all done by the firm alone, so this is internal expansion. Renting a floor from a landlord is not a merger or an acquisition.
explain_zh: 多租地方、買機器、請工人全部都係 firm 自己做，所以係 internal expansion。向業主租樓唔係 merger 或 acquisition。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Luen Fat Toys has 500 000 shares in issue. In 1986 Wing Hop Plastics buys 280 000 of these shares and takes control of Luen Fat. What percentage of the shares does Wing Hop hold, and what kind of expansion is this?
prompt_zh: （虛構）聯發玩具已發行 500 000 股。1986 年永合塑膠買入其中 280 000 股，取得聯發嘅控制權。永合持有幾多百分比嘅股份？呢個屬於邊種擴充？
options_en: 56 per cent, internal expansion|28 per cent, external expansion|56 per cent, external expansion by acquisition|44 per cent, a merger
options_zh: 56%，internal expansion|28%，external expansion|56%，透過 acquisition 嘅 external expansion|44%，merger
hint_en: Work out 280 000 out of 500 000 first, then ask whether a second firm is involved.
hint_zh: 先計 280 000 佔 500 000 幾多，再問有冇第二間 firm 參與？
explain_en: 280 000 divided by 500 000 is 56 per cent, which is more than half, so Wing Hop controls Luen Fat. One firm taking over another is an acquisition, a form of external expansion.
explain_zh: 280 000 除 500 000 等於 56%，多過一半，所以永合控制咗聯發。一間 firm 接管另一間即係 acquisition，屬於 external expansion。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Sort the moves made by Tai Shing Garment in the 1980s:
prompt_zh: （虛構）將大成製衣喺 1980 年代嘅各項行動分類：
options_en: internal expansion|external expansion
options_zh: internal expansion|external expansion
items_en: It opens its own cutting workshop on another floor of the same building.|It merges with Yuen Cheong Garment and one firm is left.|It sets up its own sales office to sell to buyers in a new market.|It buys a controlling interest in a button factory.|It moves part of its production to a new plant it builds itself north of the border.
items_zh: 佢喺同一幢大廈另一層自己開一間剪裁工場。|佢同元昌製衣合併，最後剩低一間 firm。|佢自己開一間銷售辦事處，賣畀新市場嘅買家。|佢買咗一間鈕扣廠嘅控股權益。|佢將部分生產搬去自己喺北面興建嘅新廠房。
hint_en: Count the firms involved in each move.
hint_zh: 數吓每個行動涉及幾多間 firm？
explain_en: Workshops, sales offices and a plant the firm builds itself are internal expansion. A merger and buying a controlling interest in another firm are external expansion.
explain_zh: 自己開工場、開銷售辦事處、自己起廠房都係 internal expansion。合併同買另一間 firm 嘅控股權益就係 external expansion。

prompt_en: (Fictional) In 1988 two godown firms beside the Kwun Tong ferry pier combine, and afterwards only Hoi Wah Godown remains. This is external expansion by ____. If instead Hoi Wah had simply built a second godown of its own, that would be ____ expansion.
prompt_zh: （虛構）1988 年觀塘碼頭旁邊兩間貨倉 firm 結合，之後只剩低海華貨倉。呢個係透過 ① 嘅 external expansion。如果海華只係自己起多一個貨倉，咁就係 ② expansion。
options_en: merger|acquisition|internal|external
options_zh: merger|acquisition|internal|external
hint_en: First: did two firms become one? Then: would building its own godown involve another firm?
hint_zh: 首先：係咪兩間變咗一間？然後：自己起貨倉會唔會涉及另一間 firm？
explain_en: Two firms combining into one firm is a merger. Building a second godown alone involves no other firm, so it is internal expansion.
explain_zh: 兩間 firm 結合成一間就係 merger。自己起多個貨倉冇其他 firm 參與，所以係 internal expansion。

prompt_en: (Fictional) A modern Hong Kong bubble tea chain has 12 shops. This year it opens 8 shops of its own and buys over a 5-shop chain run by another firm. How many of its 25 shops came from external expansion, and why?
prompt_zh: （虛構）一間現代香港珍珠奶茶連鎖店有 12 間分店。今年佢自己開多 8 間，又收購咗另一間 firm 旗下 5 間分店嘅連鎖店。佢 25 間分店入面有幾多間係嚟自 external expansion？點解？
options_en: 20 shops, because all the new shops make the firm bigger|8 shops, because opening shops is how firms combine|13 shops, because it now controls more shops than before|5 shops, because only those came from taking over another firm
options_zh: 20 間，因為所有新店都令 firm 大咗|8 間，因為開舖就係 firm 結合嘅方法|13 間，因為佢控制嘅分店多過以前|5 間，因為只有嗰啲係接管另一間 firm 得返嚟
hint_en: Which of the new shops used to belong to a different firm?
hint_zh: 邊啲新分店以前係屬於另一間 firm？
explain_en: The 8 self-opened shops are internal expansion. Only the 5 shops taken over from another firm come from external expansion, and 12 plus 8 plus 5 gives 25 shops in total.
explain_zh: 自己開嘅 8 間係 internal expansion。只有由另一間 firm 接管返嚟嘅 5 間先係 external expansion；12 加 8 加 5 啱啱好 25 間。

prompt_en: Horizontal expansion means expanding into a business that produces the same product, or is at the same stage of production of the same product.
prompt_zh: Horizontal expansion 即係擴充去一盤生產同一種產品，或者處於同一產品同一生產階段嘅生意。
hint_en: Is the other business making the same thing, or something at a different stage?
hint_zh: 另一盤生意係咪做緊同一樣嘢，定係做緊另一個階段？
explain_en: Horizontal expansion keeps the firm at the same product and the same stage of production; only its scale at that stage grows.
explain_zh: Horizontal expansion 令 firm 留喺同一產品、同一生產階段，只係喺嗰個階段嘅規模大咗。

prompt_en: A container terminal operator that takes over a toy factory has carried out horizontal expansion.
prompt_zh: 一間貨櫃碼頭營運商接管咗一間玩具廠，呢個係 horizontal expansion。
hint_en: Are loading containers and making toys the same product or the same stage?
hint_zh: 上落貨櫃同做玩具，係咪同一產品或者同一階段？
explain_en: Terminal services and toys are neither the same product nor the same stage of one product, so this is not horizontal expansion.
explain_zh: 碼頭服務同玩具既唔係同一產品，亦唔係同一產品嘅同一階段，所以唔係 horizontal expansion。

prompt_en: Reducing competition is a motive that applies to external horizontal expansion.
prompt_zh: 減少競爭係 external horizontal expansion 先適用嘅動機。
hint_en: When a firm combines with a rival making the same product, what happens to the number of rivals?
hint_zh: 當一間 firm 同一個做同樣產品嘅對手結合，對手數目會點？
explain_en: When a firm combines with a rival producing the same product, one competitor is removed from the market, so competition is reduced. A firm that opens its own new branches does not remove any rival.
explain_zh: 當 firm 同一個生產同樣產品嘅對手結合，市場上就少咗一個競爭者，競爭減少。自己開新分店就冇消除任何對手。

prompt_en: Two firms that both spin cotton into yarn combine into one firm. This is:
prompt_zh: 兩間都係將棉花紡成紗嘅 firm 結合成一間 firm。呢個係：
options_en: vertical backward expansion|horizontal expansion|conglomerate expansion|lateral expansion
options_zh: vertical backward expansion|horizontal expansion|conglomerate expansion|lateral expansion
hint_en: Are the two firms at the same stage of making cloth?
hint_zh: 兩間 firm 係咪處於造布嘅同一個階段？
explain_en: Both firms are at the same stage of production of the same product (spinning yarn), so combining them is horizontal expansion.
explain_zh: 兩間 firm 都處於同一產品嘅同一生產階段（紡紗），所以結合係 horizontal expansion。

prompt_en: Which of the following is an example of horizontal expansion?
prompt_zh: 以下邊個係 horizontal expansion 嘅例子？
options_en: A bakery takes over the flour mill that supplies it.|A bakery starts to sell insurance.|A bakery opens ten more bakeries of its own.|A bakery buys a fleet of delivery vans from a van dealer.
options_zh: 一間麵包店接管咗供應佢嘅麵粉廠。|一間麵包店開始賣保險。|一間麵包店自己再開多十間麵包店。|一間麵包店向車行買咗一隊送貨車。
hint_en: Which option leaves the firm producing the same product at the same stage, only on a larger scale?
hint_zh: 邊個選項令 firm 仍然做同一產品、同一階段，只係規模大咗？
explain_en: Opening more bakeries is expanding in the same product at the same stage, so it is horizontal expansion (carried out internally). Buying vans is just buying inputs, not expanding into the van business.
explain_zh: 開多啲麵包店即係喺同一產品、同一階段擴充，屬於 horizontal expansion（用 internal 方式做）。買送貨車只係買投入，唔係擴充入車輛生意。

prompt_en: Which motive applies to external horizontal expansion but NOT to internal horizontal expansion?
prompt_zh: 邊個動機適用於 external horizontal expansion，但唔適用於 internal horizontal expansion？
options_en: reducing competition by combining with a rival|enjoying economies of scale|making more efficient use of resources|making use of the brand name
options_zh: 同對手結合去減少競爭|享受 economies of scale|更有效咁運用資源|利用個品牌名
hint_en: Which motive needs a rival firm to disappear from the market?
hint_zh: 邊個動機需要有對手由市場消失？
explain_en: Economies of scale, efficient use of resources and use of the brand name can be obtained whether the firm grows on its own or combines with another. Only combining with a rival removes a competitor.
explain_zh: Economies of scale、更有效運用資源同用品牌名，無論自己長大定同人結合都做到。只有同對手結合先會除去一個競爭者。

prompt_en: Which of the following is NOT a motive for horizontal expansion?
prompt_zh: 以下邊個唔係 horizontal expansion 嘅動機？
options_en: increasing market share of the product|spreading risk by producing unrelated products|enjoying economies of scale in producing the same product|using the same brand name over a larger output
options_zh: 增加該產品嘅 market share|靠生產唔相關產品去分散風險|生產同一產品時享受 economies of scale|用同一個品牌名去賣更多產量
hint_en: If all the output is still the same product, has risk been spread?
hint_zh: 如果所有產量都仲係同一種產品，風險有冇分散到？
explain_en: Spreading risk is the motive for lateral and conglomerate expansion, which add different products. Horizontal expansion keeps the firm in one product, so it does not spread risk.
explain_zh: 分散風險係 lateral 同 conglomerate expansion 嘅動機，佢哋會加入唔同產品。Horizontal expansion 令 firm 集中喺一種產品，唔會分散風險。

prompt_en: Horizontal expansion means expanding into a business producing the ____ product, or at the same ____ of production of that product.
prompt_zh: Horizontal expansion 即係擴充入一盤生產 ① 產品，或者處於嗰種產品同一生產 ② 嘅生意。
options_en: same|different|stage|market
options_zh: 相同|唔同|階段|市場
hint_en: What must be unchanged for expansion to be called horizontal?
hint_zh: 要叫做 horizontal，有咩係一定唔變？
explain_en: The test is the same product or the same stage of production of that product; the firm simply becomes larger at that stage.
explain_zh: 準則係同一產品，或者嗰種產品嘅同一生產階段；firm 只係喺嗰個階段變大咗。

prompt_en: A firm combines with a rival making the same product in order to raise its ____ share and to reduce ____ in the market.
prompt_zh: 一間 firm 同一個生產同樣產品嘅對手結合，目的係提高佢嘅 ① share，同埋減少市場上嘅 ②。
options_en: market|cost|competition|supply
options_zh: market|cost|競爭|供應
hint_en: After the rival joins the firm, what happens to its share of sales and to the number of rivals?
hint_zh: 對手加入之後，佢嘅銷售佔比同對手數目會點變？
explain_en: External horizontal expansion adds the rival's sales to the firm, raising market share, and removes one competitor, reducing competition.
explain_zh: External horizontal expansion 將對手嘅銷售加埋落 firm 度，market share 上升，同時市場上少咗一個競爭者，競爭減少。

prompt_en: Is each case horizontal expansion or not?
prompt_zh: 以下每個個案係咪 horizontal expansion？
options_en: horizontal expansion|not horizontal expansion
options_zh: horizontal expansion|唔係 horizontal expansion
items_en: A cha chaan teng chain takes over another cha chaan teng chain.|A container terminal operator buys a second container terminal.|A biscuit maker takes over the flour mill supplying it.|A supermarket chain opens twelve more supermarkets of its own.|A garment firm buys a property firm.
items_zh: 一間茶餐廳連鎖店接管另一間茶餐廳連鎖店。|一間貨櫃碼頭營運商買多一個貨櫃碼頭。|一間餅乾廠接管供應佢嘅麵粉廠。|一間超市連鎖店自己再開十二間超市。|一間製衣 firm 買咗一間地產 firm。
hint_en: Is the new business at the same product and the same stage?
hint_zh: 新嘅業務係咪同一產品、同一階段？
explain_en: Horizontal expansion stays in the same product at the same stage. A flour mill is an earlier stage (vertical backward) and property is an unrelated product (conglomerate).
explain_zh: Horizontal expansion 留喺同一產品、同一階段。麵粉廠係較早階段（vertical backward），地產係唔相關產品（conglomerate）。

prompt_en: Sort the motives for a firm that combines with a rival making the same product:
prompt_zh: 將一間 firm 同生產同樣產品嘅對手結合嘅動機分類：
options_en: a motive for this horizontal expansion|not a motive for it
options_zh: 呢個 horizontal expansion 嘅動機|唔係佢嘅動機
items_en: enjoying economies of scale in producing that product|increasing its share of the market for that product|reducing competition in that market|securing a steady supply of raw materials|spreading risk over unrelated products
items_zh: 生產嗰種產品時享受 economies of scale|增加佢喺嗰種產品市場嘅佔有率|減少嗰個市場嘅競爭|確保原材料供應穩定|將風險分散喺唔相關嘅產品上
hint_en: Does the motive still make sense when both firms make exactly the same thing?
hint_zh: 如果兩間 firm 做緊完全一樣嘅嘢，嗰個動機仲通唔通？
explain_en: Economies of scale, market share and less competition all follow from being larger in the same product. Securing raw materials belongs to vertical backward expansion and spreading risk to lateral or conglomerate expansion.
explain_zh: Economies of scale、market share 同競爭減少，都係因為喺同一產品上做大咗。確保原材料屬於 vertical backward expansion，分散風險屬於 lateral 或 conglomerate expansion。

prompt_en: Put the chain of effects of a horizontal merger in order:
prompt_zh: 將一個 horizontal merger 嘅因果鏈排好次序：
items_en: Two firms producing the same product combine into one firm.|The combined firm produces a much larger output of that same product.|Large-scale methods and bulk buying are spread over that larger output.|The average cost of the product falls, so the firm enjoys economies of scale.
items_zh: 兩間生產同一產品嘅 firm 結合成一間。|結合後嘅 firm 生產嗰種產品嘅產量大好多。|大規模生產方法同大手買貨嘅好處攤分喺更大產量上。|該產品嘅 average cost 下跌，firm 享受到 economies of scale。
hint_en: What has to happen to output before average cost can fall?
hint_zh: Average cost 跌之前，產量要先發生咩事？
explain_en: Economies of scale come from a larger scale of production, so the combination must first raise output of the same product before average cost can fall.
explain_zh: Economies of scale 嚟自更大嘅生產規模，所以要先結合、令同一產品嘅產量上升，average cost 先會跌。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Fu Lee Biscuits and Kam Wah Biscuits both bake the same kind of soda biscuits in Kwun Tong. In 1985 they combine into one firm. This is:
prompt_zh: （虛構）富利餅乾同金華餅乾喺觀塘都係焗同一款梳打餅。1985 年佢哋結合成一間 firm。呢個係：
options_en: internal horizontal expansion|external vertical expansion|external horizontal expansion|internal lateral expansion
options_zh: internal horizontal expansion|external vertical expansion|external horizontal expansion|internal lateral expansion
hint_en: Ask two questions: is another firm involved, and is the product the same?
hint_zh: 問兩條問題：有冇另一間 firm 參與？產品係咪一樣？
explain_en: Another firm is involved, so the expansion is external; both make the same product at the same stage, so it is horizontal.
explain_zh: 有另一間 firm 參與，所以係 external；兩間都係同一產品、同一階段，所以係 horizontal。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Before combining, Fu Lee sold 30 000 packs of biscuits a month and Kam Wah sold 20 000 packs, out of a market total of 200 000 packs. What is the combined firm's market share?
prompt_zh: （虛構）結合之前，富利每月賣 30 000 包餅，金華賣 20 000 包，全個市場每月共 200 000 包。結合後嗰間 firm 嘅 market share 係幾多？
options_en: 15 per cent|25 per cent|10 per cent|50 per cent
hint_en: Add the two firms' sales, then compare with the market total.
hint_zh: 將兩間 firm 嘅銷量加埋，再同市場總量比較？
explain_en: Combined sales are 30 000 plus 20 000, which is 50 000 packs, and 50 000 out of 200 000 is 25 per cent. Raising market share this way is a motive for external horizontal expansion.
explain_zh: 合併後銷量係 30 000 加 20 000，即 50 000 包；50 000 除 200 000 等於 25%。咁樣提高 market share 正正係 external horizontal expansion 嘅動機。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Sort the results the combined biscuit firm can expect:
prompt_zh: （虛構）將結合後嗰間餅乾 firm 可以預期嘅結果分類：
options_en: a gain from horizontal expansion|not a result of horizontal expansion
options_zh: horizontal expansion 帶嚟嘅好處|唔係 horizontal expansion 帶嚟嘅結果
items_en: Buying flour and sugar in larger quantities at a lower price per bag.|One fewer rival selling the same soda biscuits.|Selling both firms' output under the better known brand name.|Profit from biscuits and profit from property moving in opposite directions.|Owning the flour mill that supplies its flour.
items_zh: 大手買麵粉同糖，每包價錢平啲。|少咗一個賣同款梳打餅嘅對手。|用比較出名嗰個品牌名賣兩間 firm 嘅產品。|餅乾同地產嘅利潤一升一跌互相抵銷。|擁有供應麵粉畀佢嘅麵粉廠。
hint_en: Which results come simply from being bigger in the same product?
hint_zh: 邊啲結果只係因為喺同一產品上變大咗？
explain_en: Bulk buying, one fewer rival and wider use of the brand name follow from a larger scale in the same product. Offsetting profits across industries and owning a supplier come from conglomerate and vertical expansion.
explain_zh: 大手入貨、少一個對手、品牌名用得更廣，都係同一產品規模變大嘅結果。跨行業利潤互相抵銷同擁有供應商，分別屬於 conglomerate 同 vertical expansion。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Yau Hing Noodles runs 9 noodle shops and opens 6 more noodle shops of its own this year. Because no other firm is involved, this is ____ expansion, and because the shops sell the same product at the same stage, it is ____ expansion.
prompt_zh: （虛構）友興麵家有 9 間麵舖，今年自己再開多 6 間麵舖。因為冇其他 firm 參與，呢個係 ① expansion；又因為啲舖賣同一產品、同一階段，所以係 ② expansion。
options_en: internal|external|horizontal|vertical
options_zh: internal|external|horizontal|vertical
hint_en: The two labels answer two different questions: how it expanded, and into what.
hint_zh: 兩個標籤答緊兩條唔同問題：點樣擴充，同擴充去邊種業務？
explain_en: Internal or external answers how the firm expanded (alone, or by combining). Horizontal, vertical, lateral or conglomerate answers into what kind of business it expanded.
explain_zh: Internal 定 external 答點樣擴充（自己做定同人結合）。Horizontal、vertical、lateral、conglomerate 答擴充入邊種業務。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Yau Hing's 9 shops each sold 400 bowls a day. The 6 new shops each sell 300 bowls a day. By how many bowls a day has the firm's daily output risen, and what is the main motive usually given for such horizontal expansion?
prompt_zh: （虛構）友興原本 9 間舖每間每日賣 400 碗。6 間新舖每間每日賣 300 碗。間 firm 每日產量增加咗幾多碗？呢類 horizontal expansion 通常嘅主要動機係乜？
options_en: 1 800 bowls, to spread risk into a different industry|1 800 bowls, to enjoy economies of scale and a larger market share in noodles|5 400 bowls, to secure a steady supply of flour|2 100 bowls, to reduce competition by removing a rival
options_zh: 1 800 碗，為咗分散風險去另一個行業|1 800 碗，為咗享受 economies of scale 同擴大麵食嘅 market share|5 400 碗，為咗確保麵粉供應穩定|2 100 碗，為咗除去對手、減少競爭
hint_en: Multiply the new shops by their daily bowls, then ask what a firm gains by doing more of the same business itself.
hint_zh: 先用新舖數目乘每日碗數，再諗自己做多啲同樣生意有咩得著？
explain_en: Six new shops times 300 bowls is 1 800 more bowls a day. The firm is still selling one product, so risk is not spread, and since it opened its own shops no rival was removed.
explain_zh: 6 間新舖乘 300 碗即每日多 1 800 碗。間 firm 仍然賣一種產品，唔算分散風險；而且佢係自己開舖，冇除去任何對手。

prompt_en: Vertical expansion means expanding into an earlier or a later stage of production of the same product.
prompt_zh: Vertical expansion 即係擴充去同一種產品嘅較早或者較遲生產階段。
hint_en: Does the firm stay at the same stage, or move up or down the chain?
hint_zh: 間 firm 係留喺同一階段，定係沿住生產鏈向上或向下行？
explain_en: Vertical expansion moves the firm to a different stage of production of the same product: backward to an earlier stage or forward to a later one.
explain_zh: Vertical expansion 令 firm 去到同一產品嘅另一個生產階段：向後去較早階段，向前去較遲階段。

prompt_en: A garment factory that takes over a cloth weaving mill has expanded vertically forward.
prompt_zh: 一間製衣廠接管咗一間織布廠，呢個係 vertical forward expansion。
hint_en: Does cloth come before or after the garment is sewn?
hint_zh: 布料係喺車衫之前定之後出現？
explain_en: Weaving cloth is an earlier stage than sewing garments, so moving into weaving is vertical backward expansion.
explain_zh: 織布係車衫之前嘅階段，所以擴充入織布係 vertical backward expansion。

prompt_en: A firm expands forward into a later stage mainly in order to secure a steady supply of its inputs.
prompt_zh: Firm 向前擴充入較遲階段，主要係為咗確保投入品供應穩定。
hint_en: Do a firm's inputs come from the stages before it or the stages after it?
hint_zh: Firm 嘅投入品係由佢之前嘅階段嚟，定係之後嘅階段嚟？
explain_en: Forward expansion moves towards the buyer, so its motive is to secure market outlets for output. Securing a steady supply of inputs is the motive for backward expansion.
explain_zh: Forward expansion 係向住買家行，動機係為產出確保銷售渠道。確保投入供應穩定係 backward expansion 嘅動機。

prompt_en: A plastics moulding factory buys the firm that produces the plastic pellets it uses. This is:
prompt_zh: 一間塑膠啤壓廠收購咗供應膠粒畀佢嘅 firm。呢個係：
options_en: vertical forward expansion|vertical backward expansion|horizontal expansion|conglomerate expansion
options_zh: vertical forward expansion|vertical backward expansion|horizontal expansion|conglomerate expansion
hint_en: Are plastic pellets made before or after moulding?
hint_zh: 膠粒係喺啤壓之前定之後製造？
explain_en: Pellets are an earlier stage than moulding, so expanding into pellets is vertical backward expansion, usually to secure a steady supply of inputs.
explain_zh: 膠粒係啤壓之前嘅階段，所以擴充入膠粒係 vertical backward expansion，通常為咗確保投入供應穩定。

prompt_en: A toy factory opens its own chain of toy shops. The main motive for this vertical forward expansion is to:
prompt_zh: 一間玩具廠自己開埋玩具連鎖店。呢個 vertical forward expansion 嘅主要動機係：
options_en: secure a steady supply of plastic pellets|spread risk by entering an unrelated industry|secure market outlets for its own toys|reduce the number of toy factories in the market
options_zh: 確保膠粒供應穩定|進入唔相關行業去分散風險|為自己嘅玩具確保銷售渠道|減少市場上玩具廠嘅數目
hint_en: Owning the shops guarantees the factory what?
hint_zh: 擁有啲舖頭，可以保證間廠有咩？
explain_en: Retailing is a later stage than manufacturing, so this is forward expansion, whose motive is to secure outlets for the firm's output.
explain_zh: 零售係製造之後嘅階段，所以係 forward expansion，動機係為自己嘅產出確保銷售渠道。

prompt_en: Which pair correctly matches the direction of vertical expansion with its motive?
prompt_zh: 邊一對啱啱好將 vertical expansion 嘅方向同動機配對？
options_en: backward with securing market outlets, forward with securing input supply|backward with securing input supply, forward with securing market outlets|backward with spreading risk, forward with reducing competition|backward with reducing competition, forward with spreading risk
options_zh: backward 配確保銷售渠道，forward 配確保投入供應|backward 配確保投入供應，forward 配確保銷售渠道|backward 配分散風險，forward 配減少競爭|backward 配減少競爭，forward 配分散風險
hint_en: Inputs come in at the start of the chain; the output goes out at the end. Which end is which?
hint_zh: 投入喺生產鏈頭嚟，產出喺鏈尾出去。邊一端係邊個？
explain_en: Backward expansion is towards the supply of inputs, so its motive is a steady input supply. Forward expansion is towards the buyer, so its motive is secure outlets for output.
explain_zh: Backward expansion 向住投入嗰邊，動機係穩定嘅投入供應。Forward expansion 向住買家嗰邊，動機係為產出確保銷售渠道。

prompt_en: In the chain cotton to cloth to garment to retail shop, a cloth weaving mill that takes over a garment factory has expanded:
prompt_zh: 喺「棉花 → 布 → 成衣 → 零售舖」嘅生產鏈入面，一間織布廠接管咗一間製衣廠，呢個係：
options_en: vertically forward, into a later stage|vertically backward, into an earlier stage|horizontally, into the same stage|laterally, into a related but non-competing product
options_zh: vertical forward，去到較遲階段|vertical backward，去到較早階段|horizontal，去到同一階段|lateral，去到相關但唔競爭嘅產品
hint_en: Which comes first in the chain, weaving cloth or sewing garments?
hint_zh: 喺條鏈入面，織布同車衫邊個行先？
explain_en: Cloth is woven before garments are sewn, so the mill has moved to a later stage, which is vertical forward expansion.
explain_zh: 先織布，後車衫，所以織布廠係去咗較遲嘅階段，屬於 vertical forward expansion。

prompt_en: Expanding into an earlier stage of production is vertical ____ expansion, and its motive is to secure a steady supply of ____.
prompt_zh: 擴充入較早嘅生產階段係 vertical ① expansion，動機係確保 ② 嘅供應穩定。
options_en: backward|forward|inputs|outlets
options_zh: backward|forward|投入品|銷售渠道
hint_en: Which direction moves the firm towards its suppliers?
hint_zh: 邊個方向係向住佢嘅供應商行？
explain_en: Backward means towards the earlier stages, where the firm's inputs come from, so the motive is a secure supply of inputs.
explain_zh: Backward 即係向住較早階段，即係 firm 嘅投入嚟源，所以動機係確保投入供應。

prompt_en: A toy factory that opens its own retail shops has expanded vertical ____, in order to secure market ____ for its output.
prompt_zh: 一間玩具廠自己開零售舖，係 vertical ① expansion，目的係為產出確保市場 ②。
options_en: forward|backward|outlets|supply
options_zh: forward|backward|渠道|供應
hint_en: Retailing comes at which end of the production chain?
hint_zh: 零售喺生產鏈嘅邊一端？
explain_en: Retailing is a later stage than manufacturing, so it is forward expansion, and its motive is to secure outlets for the firm's output.
explain_zh: 零售係製造之後嘅階段，所以係 forward expansion，動機係為 firm 嘅產出確保銷售渠道。

prompt_en: Sort each move made by a garment factory:
prompt_zh: 將一間製衣廠嘅各項行動分類：
options_en: vertical backward expansion|vertical forward expansion|not vertical expansion
options_zh: vertical backward expansion|vertical forward expansion|唔係 vertical expansion
items_en: It takes over the dyeing factory that dyes its cloth.|It opens its own clothing shops in shopping centres.|It buys the spinning mill that makes its yarn.|It merges with another garment factory making the same shirts.|It sets up its own mail order sales department selling to final buyers.
items_zh: 佢接管咗為佢染布嘅染廠。|佢喺商場自己開服裝舖。|佢買咗生產紗線畀佢嘅紡紗廠。|佢同另一間做同款恤衫嘅製衣廠合併。|佢自己成立郵購部門，直接賣畀最終買家。
hint_en: For each move, is the new business earlier, later, or at the same stage as sewing garments?
hint_zh: 每個行動嘅新業務，相對車衫係較早、較遲，定係同一階段？
explain_en: Dyeing and spinning are earlier stages (backward). Shops and direct selling are later stages (forward). Another garment factory is the same stage, which is horizontal, not vertical.
explain_zh: 染布同紡紗係較早階段（backward）。開舖同直接銷售係較遲階段（forward）。另一間製衣廠係同一階段，屬於 horizontal，唔係 vertical。

prompt_en: Sort the statements about vertical expansion:
prompt_zh: 將有關 vertical expansion 嘅講法分類：
options_en: true of backward expansion|true of forward expansion
options_zh: backward expansion 嘅特徵|forward expansion 嘅特徵
items_en: The firm moves into an earlier stage of production.|The firm moves closer to the final buyer.|The firm need not fear that suppliers stop delivery or raise prices.|The firm makes sure its output can always be sold.
items_zh: Firm 進入較早嘅生產階段。|Firm 更加接近最終買家。|Firm 唔使驚供應商斷貨或者加價。|Firm 確保自己嘅產出一定有得賣。
hint_en: Is the stage before or after the firm's own stage?
hint_zh: 嗰個階段係喺 firm 自己嘅階段之前定之後？
explain_en: Backward expansion goes to earlier stages to secure inputs; forward expansion goes to later stages to secure outlets.
explain_zh: Backward expansion 去較早階段，確保投入；forward expansion 去較遲階段，確保銷售渠道。

prompt_en: Put the stages of making and selling a cotton shirt in order:
prompt_zh: 將生產同銷售一件棉恤衫嘅階段排好次序：
items_en: growing cotton|spinning the cotton into yarn and weaving cloth|cutting and sewing the cloth into garments|selling the shirt in a retail shop
items_zh: 種棉花|將棉花紡成紗再織成布|剪裁同車縫成衣|喺零售舖賣恤衫
hint_en: Which stage must be finished before the next one can start?
hint_zh: 邊個階段要完成咗，下一個先開始到？
explain_en: Expanding towards an earlier stage in this chain is backward expansion; expanding towards a later stage is forward expansion.
explain_zh: 喺呢條鏈向較早階段擴充就係 backward expansion；向較遲階段擴充就係 forward expansion。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Sun Cheong Toys moulds plastic toys on the fifth floor of a Kwun Tong factory building, sending finished toys down by the goods lift. In 1984 it buys Tak Lee Plastics, the firm that supplies its plastic pellets. Sun Cheong has carried out:
prompt_zh: （虛構）新昌玩具喺觀塘一幢工廠大廈五樓啤塑膠玩具，做好就用貨梯運落樓。1984 年佢收購咗供應膠粒畀佢嘅德利塑膠。新昌做咗：
options_en: external horizontal expansion|external vertical backward expansion|internal vertical forward expansion|external conglomerate expansion
options_zh: external horizontal expansion|external vertical backward expansion|internal vertical forward expansion|external conglomerate expansion
hint_en: Two questions: is another firm involved, and is the pellet stage before or after moulding?
hint_zh: 兩條問題：有冇另一間 firm 參與？膠粒階段係喺啤壓之前定之後？
explain_en: Buying another firm makes it external, and pellets are an earlier stage than moulding, so it is vertical backward expansion.
explain_zh: 收購另一間 firm 即係 external，而膠粒係啤壓之前嘅階段，所以係 vertical backward expansion。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Before the takeover, Tak Lee charged Sun Cheong $8 per kilogram of pellets, and Sun Cheong used 5 000 kilograms a month. After the takeover the pellets cost the group $6 per kilogram to produce. By how much do the group's monthly pellet costs fall?
prompt_zh: （虛構）收購之前，德利每公斤膠粒收新昌 $8，新昌每月用 5 000 公斤。收購之後，集團自己生產每公斤成本 $6。集團每月膠粒成本減少幾多？
hint_en: Work out the monthly cost before and after, then take the difference.
hint_zh: 分別計收購前後每月成本，再相減？
explain_en: Before: 5 000 times $8 equals $40 000. After: 5 000 times $6 equals $30 000. The saving is $10 000 a month, on top of the steadier supply of inputs.
explain_zh: 之前：5 000 乘 $8 等於 $40 000。之後：5 000 乘 $6 等於 $30 000。每月慳到 $10 000，仲有更穩定嘅投入供應。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Sort Sun Cheong's later moves:
prompt_zh: （虛構）將新昌之後嘅行動分類：
options_en: vertical backward expansion|vertical forward expansion|horizontal expansion
options_zh: vertical backward expansion|vertical forward expansion|horizontal expansion
items_en: It opens its own toy shops in Hong Kong shopping centres.|It buys a mould making workshop that makes the moulds it uses.|It takes over another toy moulding factory making the same toys.|It sets up its own delivery and wholesale arm to sell direct to shops.|It acquires a colour pigment supplier.
items_zh: 佢喺香港商場自己開玩具舖。|佢買咗一間為佢做模具嘅模具工場。|佢接管咗另一間做同款玩具嘅啤塑廠。|佢自己成立送貨兼批發部門，直接賣畀舖頭。|佢收購咗一間色粉供應商。
hint_en: Place each business before, after, or at the same point as toy moulding.
hint_zh: 將每盤生意放喺啤玩具之前、之後，定係同一點？
explain_en: Moulds and pigments are inputs, so they are earlier stages (backward). Shops and wholesaling are closer to the buyer (forward). Another toy moulding factory is the same stage (horizontal).
explain_zh: 模具同色粉係投入，屬較早階段（backward）。開舖同批發更接近買家（forward）。另一間啤玩具廠係同一階段（horizontal）。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Kwong Fat Bakery buys the flour mill that supplies it, then opens its own bread shops. Buying the mill is vertical ____ expansion, and opening the shops is vertical ____ expansion.
prompt_zh: （虛構）廣發餅家買咗供應佢麵粉嘅麵粉廠，之後又自己開麵包舖。買麵粉廠係 vertical ① expansion，開舖就係 vertical ② expansion。
options_en: backward|forward|lateral|conglomerate
options_zh: backward|forward|lateral|conglomerate
hint_en: Flour comes before baking, and shops come after. Which direction is each?
hint_zh: 麵粉喺焗麵包之前，舖頭喺之後。各自係邊個方向？
explain_en: Moving to an earlier stage is backward expansion and moving to a later stage is forward expansion; both are vertical because they stay in the same product chain.
explain_zh: 去較早階段係 backward expansion，去較遲階段係 forward expansion；兩者都留喺同一條產品鏈，所以都係 vertical。

prompt_en: (Fictional) A Hong Kong milk tea chain buys a tea leaf blending workshop and also opens 10 more shops of its own. Which description is correct?
prompt_zh: （虛構）一間香港奶茶連鎖店收購咗一間茶葉拼配工場，同時自己再開 10 間分店。以下邊個描述正確？
options_en: Both moves are vertical backward expansion.|Buying the blending workshop is external vertical backward expansion, and opening the shops is internal horizontal expansion.|Buying the blending workshop is horizontal expansion, and opening the shops is vertical forward expansion.|Both moves are conglomerate expansion, because two different businesses are involved.
options_zh: 兩個行動都係 vertical backward expansion。|收購拼配工場係 external vertical backward expansion，自己開舖係 internal horizontal expansion。|收購拼配工場係 horizontal expansion，自己開舖係 vertical forward expansion。|兩個行動都係 conglomerate expansion，因為涉及兩盤唔同生意。
hint_en: Blending tea leaves happens before the drink is sold; the new shops sell exactly what the old shops sell.
hint_zh: 拼配茶葉喺賣奶茶之前發生；新舖賣嘅嘢同舊舖一模一樣。
explain_en: The workshop is an earlier stage bought from another firm, so it is external vertical backward expansion. The extra shops are the same product at the same stage, opened alone, so they are internal horizontal expansion.
explain_zh: 工場係向另一間 firm 買返嚟嘅較早階段，所以係 external vertical backward expansion。新分店係同一產品、同一階段，又係自己開，所以係 internal horizontal expansion。

prompt_en: Lateral expansion means expanding into a business producing related but non-competing products.
prompt_zh: Lateral expansion 即係擴充入一盤生產相關但唔互相競爭產品嘅生意。
hint_en: Are the two products rivals for the same buyers, or do they simply go well together?
hint_zh: 兩種產品係爭同一班買家，定係只係好夾？
explain_en: Lateral expansion adds a product that is related, for example using similar materials or skills, but does not compete with the firm's existing product.
explain_zh: Lateral expansion 加入一種相關嘅產品，例如用相似材料或者技術，但唔同 firm 原有產品競爭。

prompt_en: A garment firm that buys a property firm has carried out lateral expansion.
prompt_zh: 一間製衣 firm 買咗一間地產 firm，呢個係 lateral expansion。
hint_en: Are clothes and flats related products?
hint_zh: 衫同樓係咪相關產品？
explain_en: Garments and property are unrelated, so this is conglomerate expansion. Lateral expansion needs products that are related but not competing.
explain_zh: 成衣同地產完全唔相關，所以係 conglomerate expansion。Lateral expansion 要求產品相關但唔競爭。

prompt_en: Spreading risk through diversification is a motive for both lateral and conglomerate expansion.
prompt_zh: 透過 diversification 分散風險，係 lateral 同 conglomerate expansion 共同嘅動機。
hint_en: If one product sells badly, does the firm still have other products to fall back on?
hint_zh: 如果一種產品賣得差，firm 仲有冇其他產品頂住？
explain_en: Both types add different products, so a fall in demand for one product need not ruin the whole firm. That is diversification of risk.
explain_zh: 兩種擴充都加入唔同產品，一種產品需求下跌唔一定拖垮成間 firm，呢個就係分散風險。

prompt_en: A biscuit maker starts to make sweets as well. This is:
prompt_zh: 一間餅乾廠開始同時生產糖果。呢個係：
options_en: horizontal expansion|lateral expansion|conglomerate expansion|vertical forward expansion
options_zh: horizontal expansion|lateral expansion|conglomerate expansion|vertical forward expansion
hint_en: Biscuits and sweets use similar materials and shops, but do buyers treat them as the same product?
hint_zh: 餅乾同糖果用相似材料同銷售渠道，但買家會唔會當佢哋係同一種產品？
explain_en: Sweets are related to biscuits but do not compete as the same product, so this is lateral expansion.
explain_zh: 糖果同餅乾相關，但唔係同一種產品嘅競爭對手，所以係 lateral expansion。

prompt_en: A garment firm buys a property firm. This is:
prompt_zh: 一間製衣 firm 買咗一間地產 firm。呢個係：
options_en: lateral expansion, because both need buildings|vertical backward expansion, because factories need premises|horizontal expansion, because both are businesses|conglomerate expansion, because the two products are unrelated
options_zh: lateral expansion，因為兩者都要用樓|vertical backward expansion，因為工廠要廠房|horizontal expansion，因為兩者都係生意|conglomerate expansion，因為兩種產品完全唔相關
hint_en: Is there any production link between sewing clothes and selling flats?
hint_zh: 車衫同賣樓之間，有冇任何生產上嘅關係？
explain_en: Conglomerate expansion is into an unrelated product. Needing premises is not a production link, so it does not make property a related product.
explain_zh: Conglomerate expansion 係擴充入唔相關嘅產品。要用樓宇唔算生產上嘅關聯，所以地產唔會因此變成相關產品。

prompt_en: Which of the following is the motive shared by lateral and conglomerate expansion?
prompt_zh: 以下邊個係 lateral 同 conglomerate expansion 共同嘅動機？
options_en: spreading risk through diversification of products|securing a steady supply of raw materials|securing outlets for the firm's output|removing a rival producing the same product
options_zh: 透過產品 diversification 分散風險|確保原材料供應穩定|為 firm 嘅產出確保銷售渠道|除去一個生產同樣產品嘅對手
hint_en: What do both types give the firm that a single product cannot?
hint_zh: 兩種擴充畀到 firm 啲乜，係單一產品做唔到？
explain_en: Both add products other than the firm's original one, so a fall in one market can be offset by another. Securing inputs and outlets are vertical motives; removing a rival is a horizontal one.
explain_zh: 兩者都加入原有產品以外嘅產品，一個市場跌可以由另一個補返。確保投入同銷售渠道係 vertical 嘅動機，除去對手係 horizontal 嘅動機。

prompt_en: A biscuit maker takes over another biscuit maker. This is NOT lateral expansion because:
prompt_zh: 一間餅乾廠接管另一間餅乾廠，呢個唔係 lateral expansion，因為：
options_en: the two firms are of different sizes|the two firms produce the same competing product|no money changes hands|biscuits are an unrelated product
options_zh: 兩間 firm 規模唔同|兩間 firm 生產同一種互相競爭嘅產品|冇錢轉手|餅乾係唔相關嘅產品
hint_en: Lateral expansion needs products that do not compete. Do two biscuit makers compete?
hint_zh: Lateral expansion 要求產品唔互相競爭。兩間餅乾廠爭唔爭生意？
explain_en: Two biscuit makers sell competing products at the same stage, which is horizontal expansion. Lateral expansion requires related but non-competing products.
explain_zh: 兩間餅乾廠喺同一階段賣互相競爭嘅產品，屬於 horizontal expansion。Lateral expansion 要求產品相關但唔競爭。

prompt_en: Expanding into related but non-competing products is ____ expansion, while expanding into completely unrelated products is ____ expansion.
prompt_zh: 擴充入相關但唔競爭嘅產品係 ① expansion，擴充入完全唔相關嘅產品就係 ② expansion。
options_en: lateral|conglomerate|horizontal|vertical
options_zh: lateral|conglomerate|horizontal|vertical
hint_en: How closely are the two products related in each case?
hint_zh: 兩個情況入面，兩種產品嘅關係有幾密切？
explain_en: Lateral: related but non-competing products. Conglomerate: unrelated products. Both differ from horizontal, where the product is the same.
explain_zh: Lateral：相關但唔競爭嘅產品。Conglomerate：唔相關嘅產品。兩者都同 horizontal 唔同，horizontal 係同一種產品。

prompt_en: By producing several different products, a firm can ____ its risk, because a fall in the demand for one product need not ruin the ____ firm.
prompt_zh: 生產幾種唔同產品，可以令 firm ① 風險，因為一種產品需求下跌，唔一定拖垮 ② firm。
options_en: spread|raise|whole|rival
options_zh: 分散|提高|成間|對手嗰間
hint_en: If one product does badly, what keeps the firm going?
hint_zh: 如果一種產品做得差，靠咩撐住間 firm？
explain_en: Diversification into different products spreads risk: losses in one market can be offset by profits in another, so the whole firm is less exposed.
explain_zh: 分散去唔同產品即係分散風險：一個市場蝕可以由另一個市場賺返，成間 firm 嘅風險細啲。

prompt_en: Sort each expansion by a biscuit maker:
prompt_zh: 將一間餅乾廠嘅各項擴充分類：
options_en: lateral expansion|conglomerate expansion|horizontal expansion
options_zh: lateral expansion|conglomerate expansion|horizontal expansion
items_en: It starts to make sweets.|It starts to make instant noodles.|It buys a car park operator.|It takes over another biscuit maker.|It buys an insurance firm.
items_zh: 佢開始做糖果。|佢開始做即食麵。|佢買咗一間停車場營運商。|佢接管另一間餅乾廠。|佢買咗一間保險 firm。
hint_en: Ask whether the new product is the same as, related to, or unrelated to biscuits.
hint_zh: 問吓新產品同餅乾係相同、相關，定係完全唔相關？
explain_en: Same product: horizontal. Related but not competing (other snack foods): lateral. Unrelated (car parks, insurance): conglomerate.
explain_zh: 相同產品：horizontal。相關但唔競爭（其他零食）：lateral。完全唔相關（停車場、保險）：conglomerate。

prompt_en: Sort the statements about lateral and conglomerate expansion:
prompt_zh: 將有關 lateral 同 conglomerate expansion 嘅講法分類：
options_en: correct|incorrect
options_zh: 正確|錯誤
items_en: Both can spread the firm's risk over more than one product.|Lateral expansion adds a product related to the existing one.|Conglomerate expansion adds a product at an earlier stage of the same chain.|Lateral expansion is mainly used to secure a steady supply of inputs.
items_zh: 兩者都可以將 firm 嘅風險分散喺多過一種產品上。|Lateral expansion 加入一種同現有產品相關嘅產品。|Conglomerate expansion 加入同一條鏈上較早階段嘅產品。|Lateral expansion 主要係為咗確保投入供應穩定。
hint_en: Which statements describe vertical expansion instead?
hint_zh: 邊啲講法其實係講緊 vertical expansion？
explain_en: Adding an earlier stage of the same chain is vertical backward expansion, and securing inputs is its motive. Lateral and conglomerate expansion add other products to spread risk.
explain_zh: 加入同一條鏈嘅較早階段係 vertical backward expansion，確保投入係佢嘅動機。Lateral 同 conglomerate expansion 係加入其他產品去分散風險。

prompt_en: Put the reasoning for diversification in order:
prompt_zh: 將 diversification 嘅推理排好次序：
items_en: The firm produces only one product.|Demand for that product falls sharply in a bad season.|The whole firm's profit falls with it.|The firm expands into other products so that losses in one market can be offset by another.
items_zh: Firm 只係生產一種產品。|淡季嗰種產品嘅需求大跌。|成間 firm 嘅利潤跟住跌。|Firm 擴充入其他產品，一個市場嘅虧損可以由另一個市場補返。
hint_en: What problem must appear before diversification looks attractive?
hint_zh: 要出現咩問題，diversification 先會吸引？
explain_en: Relying on one product makes the firm's profit depend on one market. Adding other products through lateral or conglomerate expansion spreads that risk.
explain_zh: 只靠一種產品，令 firm 嘅利潤取決於一個市場。透過 lateral 或 conglomerate expansion 加入其他產品，就可以分散呢個風險。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Yee Fung Biscuits in Kwun Tong makes soda biscuits. In 1987 it starts a new line making candy sweets in the same building, using the same sugar suppliers and the same grocery shops. Yee Fung has carried out:
prompt_zh: （虛構）觀塘嘅怡豐餅乾做梳打餅。1987 年佢喺同一幢大廈開一條新生產線做糖果，用同一批糖供應商同同一批雜貨舖。怡豐做咗：
options_en: horizontal expansion|lateral expansion|vertical forward expansion|conglomerate expansion
options_zh: horizontal expansion|lateral expansion|vertical forward expansion|conglomerate expansion
hint_en: Are sweets the same product as biscuits, or a related one that does not compete with them?
hint_zh: 糖果同餅乾係同一種產品，定係相關但唔互相競爭嘅產品？
explain_en: Sweets are related to biscuits through materials and outlets but are not the same competing product, so this is lateral expansion.
explain_zh: 糖果同餅乾喺材料同銷售渠道上相關，但唔係同一種互相競爭嘅產品，所以係 lateral expansion。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Two years later Yee Fung buys Tai Yau Property, a firm that rents out office space. This second move is:
prompt_zh: （虛構）兩年後怡豐收購咗大友地產，一間出租寫字樓嘅 firm。第二個行動係：
options_en: lateral expansion, because both are businesses in Kwun Tong|vertical backward expansion, because factories need premises|conglomerate expansion, because office space is unrelated to biscuits|horizontal expansion, because the firm gets bigger
options_zh: lateral expansion，因為兩者都係觀塘嘅生意|vertical backward expansion，因為工廠要用廠房|conglomerate expansion，因為寫字樓同餅乾完全唔相關|horizontal expansion，因為間 firm 大咗
hint_en: Is there a production link between baking biscuits and renting out offices?
hint_zh: 焗餅同出租寫字樓之間有冇生產上嘅關聯？
explain_en: Office space and biscuits are unrelated products, so the move is conglomerate expansion, made to spread risk.
explain_zh: 寫字樓同餅乾係唔相關嘅產品，所以呢個行動係 conglomerate expansion，目的係分散風險。

prompt_en: (Fictional) In a bad year Yee Fung's biscuit line loses $600 000, its sweets line earns $250 000 and its property arm earns $500 000. What is the group's overall profit or loss, and what does this show?
prompt_zh: （虛構）喺一個淡年，怡豐嘅餅乾線蝕 $600 000，糖果線賺 $250 000，地產部賺 $500 000。集團整體係賺定蝕？呢點說明咩？
options_en: a loss of $600 000, showing diversification does not help|a profit of $150 000, showing how diversification spreads risk|a profit of $750 000, showing economies of scale|a loss of $350 000, showing conglomerate expansion always fails
options_zh: 蝕 $600 000，說明 diversification 冇用|賺 $150 000，說明 diversification 點樣分散風險|賺 $750 000，說明 economies of scale|蝕 $350 000，說明 conglomerate expansion 一定失敗
hint_en: Add the three results together first, then ask why the group survives the bad year.
hint_zh: 先將三個結果加埋，再諗點解集團捱得過淡年？
explain_en: Minus $600 000 plus $250 000 plus $500 000 gives a profit of $150 000. Profits from the other products offset the loss on biscuits, which is exactly how diversification spreads risk.
explain_zh: 負 $600 000 加 $250 000 加 $500 000 等於賺 $150 000。其他產品嘅利潤補返餅乾嘅虧損，正正就係 diversification 分散風險嘅作用。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Sort each move by Ming Kee Soy Sauce, which brews soy sauce:
prompt_zh: （虛構）明記醬油係釀豉油嘅，將佢嘅各項行動分類：
options_en: lateral expansion|conglomerate expansion|neither lateral nor conglomerate
options_zh: lateral expansion|conglomerate expansion|兩者都唔係
items_en: It starts to brew vinegar as well.|It starts to make chilli sauce.|It buys a minibus operator.|It takes over another soy sauce maker.|It buys the soya bean wholesaler that supplies it.
items_zh: 佢開始同時釀醋。|佢開始做辣椒醬。|佢買咗一間小巴營運商。|佢接管另一間豉油廠。|佢買咗供應黃豆畀佢嘅批發商。
hint_en: For each, ask: same product, related product, or unrelated product?
hint_zh: 每個都問：同一產品、相關產品，定係唔相關產品？
explain_en: Vinegar and chilli sauce are related sauces that do not compete with soy sauce (lateral). Minibuses are unrelated (conglomerate). Another soy sauce maker is horizontal and the bean wholesaler is vertical backward.
explain_zh: 醋同辣椒醬係相關而唔同豉油競爭嘅調味料（lateral）。小巴完全唔相關（conglomerate）。另一間豉油廠係 horizontal，黃豆批發商係 vertical backward。

prompt_en: (Fictional) A modern Hong Kong coffee chain starts selling its own bottled fruit juice, then buys a driving school. Adding fruit juice is ____ expansion, and buying the driving school is ____ expansion.
prompt_zh: （虛構）一間現代香港咖啡連鎖店開始賣自家樽裝果汁，之後又買咗一間駕駛學院。加入果汁係 ① expansion，買駕駛學院係 ② expansion。
options_en: lateral|conglomerate|horizontal|vertical
options_zh: lateral|conglomerate|horizontal|vertical
hint_en: Which new business is still a drink, and which has nothing to do with drinks?
hint_zh: 邊盤新生意仍然係飲品，邊盤同飲品完全冇關？
explain_en: Juice is a related drink that does not compete directly with coffee, so it is lateral. Driving lessons are unrelated to drinks, so that is conglomerate expansion; both spread risk.
explain_zh: 果汁係相關飲品，同咖啡唔直接競爭，所以係 lateral。教車同飲品完全冇關，所以係 conglomerate expansion；兩者都可以分散風險。

prompt_en: Making use of the firm's brand name is a motive for horizontal expansion only.
prompt_zh: 利用 firm 嘅品牌名，只係 horizontal expansion 先有嘅動機。
hint_en: Can a firm put its well known name on a related new product as well?
hint_zh: Firm 可唔可以將個響噹噹嘅名擺埋喺一種相關嘅新產品上？
explain_en: Economies of scale, more efficient use of resources and use of the brand name are common to all types of expansion; only motives such as reducing competition or securing inputs are tied to one type.
explain_zh: Economies of scale、更有效運用資源同利用品牌名，係所有類型擴充共通；只有例如減少競爭、確保投入呢啲動機先綁死喺某一類型。

prompt_en: Spreading risk is the main motive for horizontal expansion.
prompt_zh: 分散風險係 horizontal expansion 嘅主要動機。
hint_en: After horizontal expansion, how many products does the firm sell?
hint_zh: Horizontal expansion 之後，間 firm 賣緊幾多種產品？
explain_en: Horizontal expansion keeps the firm in the same product, so risk is not spread. Spreading risk is the motive for lateral and conglomerate expansion.
explain_zh: Horizontal expansion 令 firm 留喺同一種產品，風險冇分散。分散風險係 lateral 同 conglomerate expansion 嘅動機。

prompt_en: A firm that expands backward into the production of its own inputs need not worry about a supplier suddenly stopping delivery.
prompt_zh: 一間 firm 向後擴充、自己生產投入品，就唔使擔心供應商突然斷貨。
hint_en: Who supplies the inputs after the firm owns the earlier stage?
hint_zh: 當 firm 擁有咗較早階段之後，邊個供應投入品？
explain_en: Owning the earlier stage means the firm supplies itself, which is exactly the motive of securing a steady supply of inputs.
explain_zh: 擁有較早階段即係自己供應自己，正正就係確保投入供應穩定呢個動機。

prompt_en: Which motive is common to all types of expansion?
prompt_zh: 邊個動機係所有類型擴充共通？
options_en: reducing competition in the market|securing outlets for output|making use of the firm's brand name over a larger business|spreading risk over different products
options_zh: 減少市場上嘅競爭|為產出確保銷售渠道|喺更大嘅生意上利用 firm 嘅品牌名|將風險分散喺唔同產品上
hint_en: Which benefit does a firm get simply because it is larger?
hint_zh: 邊個好處只係因為 firm 大咗就會有？
explain_en: Economies of scale, more efficient use of resources and use of the brand name follow from being larger, whatever the type. The other three motives belong to particular types.
explain_zh: Economies of scale、更有效運用資源同利用品牌名，只要規模大咗就會有，唔分類型。其餘三個動機各自屬於特定類型。

prompt_en: A firm wants to make sure its factory never runs short of raw materials. The suitable expansion is:
prompt_zh: 一間 firm 想確保間廠永遠唔會缺原材料。適合嘅擴充係：
options_en: vertical backward expansion|vertical forward expansion|horizontal expansion|conglomerate expansion
options_zh: vertical backward expansion|vertical forward expansion|horizontal expansion|conglomerate expansion
hint_en: Where in the production chain do raw materials come from?
hint_zh: 原材料喺生產鏈邊個位置嚟？
explain_en: Raw materials come from earlier stages, so moving backward into those stages secures the supply of inputs.
explain_zh: 原材料嚟自較早階段，所以向後擴充入嗰啲階段就可以確保投入供應。

prompt_en: A manufacturer is afraid that retailers may refuse to stock its goods. Which expansion meets this worry?
prompt_zh: 一間製造商擔心零售商唔肯入佢啲貨。邊種擴充可以處理呢個憂慮？
options_en: vertical backward expansion into raw materials|horizontal expansion into another factory making the same goods|conglomerate expansion into an unrelated industry|vertical forward expansion into retailing
options_zh: 向後擴充入原材料嘅 vertical backward expansion|橫向擴充入另一間做同樣貨品嘅工廠|擴充入唔相關行業嘅 conglomerate expansion|向前擴充入零售嘅 vertical forward expansion
hint_en: If the firm owns the shops, who decides what is on the shelves?
hint_zh: 如果 firm 自己擁有啲舖，邊個決定貨架上擺咩？
explain_en: Retailing is a later stage, so forward expansion gives the firm its own outlets and secures a market for its output.
explain_zh: 零售係較遲階段，所以向前擴充令 firm 有自己嘅銷售渠道，為產出確保市場。

prompt_en: Which motive belongs ONLY to external horizontal expansion?
prompt_zh: 邊個動機只屬於 external horizontal expansion？
options_en: enjoying economies of scale|removing a rival and so reducing competition|using resources more efficiently|making use of the brand name
options_zh: 享受 economies of scale|除去一個對手，從而減少競爭|更有效咁運用資源|利用個品牌名
hint_en: Which motive is impossible unless a competing firm is absorbed?
hint_zh: 邊個動機一定要吸納一個競爭對手先做得到？
explain_en: Only combining with a firm producing the same product removes a competitor. The other three follow from larger scale in any type of expansion.
explain_zh: 只有同生產同樣產品嘅 firm 結合先會除去一個競爭者。其餘三個係任何類型擴充規模變大都會有。

prompt_en: A firm expands backward to secure a steady supply of ____, and expands forward to secure market ____ for its output.
prompt_zh: Firm 向後擴充係為咗確保 ① 供應穩定，向前擴充係為咗為產出確保市場 ②。
options_en: inputs|profits|outlets|shares
options_zh: 投入品|利潤|渠道|股份
hint_en: One direction faces the suppliers and the other faces the buyers.
hint_zh: 一個方向面向供應商，另一個面向買家，各自想要咩？
explain_en: Backward expansion secures inputs from earlier stages; forward expansion secures outlets at later stages.
explain_zh: Backward expansion 由較早階段確保投入；forward expansion 喺較遲階段確保銷售渠道。

prompt_en: Lateral and conglomerate expansion both aim to ____ risk, while external horizontal expansion can also ____ competition.
prompt_zh: Lateral 同 conglomerate expansion 都係為咗 ① 風險，而 external horizontal expansion 仲可以 ② 競爭。
options_en: spread|increase|reduce|secure
options_zh: 分散|增加|減少|確保
hint_en: What does adding new products do, and what does absorbing a rival do?
hint_zh: 加入新產品有咩作用？吸納對手又有咩作用？
explain_en: Adding different products spreads risk; absorbing a firm making the same product removes a competitor and reduces competition.
explain_zh: 加入唔同產品可以分散風險；吸納生產同樣產品嘅 firm 就除去咗一個競爭者，令競爭減少。

prompt_en: Match each motive to the type of expansion it belongs to:
prompt_zh: 將每個動機配對返佢所屬嘅擴充類型：
options_en: vertical backward expansion|vertical forward expansion|lateral or conglomerate expansion
options_zh: vertical backward expansion|vertical forward expansion|lateral 或 conglomerate expansion
items_en: securing a steady supply of raw materials|making sure the firm's output always has shops to sell it|spreading risk over several different products|owning the workshop that makes the moulds the firm uses|owning the shops that sell the firm's goods
items_zh: 確保原材料供應穩定|確保 firm 嘅產出永遠有舖頭賣|將風險分散喺幾種唔同產品上|擁有為 firm 造模具嘅工場|擁有賣 firm 貨品嘅舖頭
hint_en: Is the motive about getting inputs in, getting output out, or holding different products?
hint_zh: 個動機係講攞投入入嚟、將產出賣出去，定係持有唔同產品？
explain_en: Inputs and suppliers point backward, outlets and shops point forward, and different products point to lateral or conglomerate expansion.
explain_zh: 投入同供應商指向 backward，銷售渠道同舖頭指向 forward，唔同產品就指向 lateral 或 conglomerate expansion。

prompt_en: Sort the motives for expansion:
prompt_zh: 將擴充嘅動機分類：
options_en: common to all types of expansion|specific to one type of expansion
options_zh: 所有類型擴充共通|只屬於某一種擴充
items_en: enjoying economies of scale|using resources more efficiently|making use of the brand name|reducing competition by absorbing a rival|securing a steady supply of inputs|spreading risk over different products
items_zh: 享受 economies of scale|更有效咁運用資源|利用個品牌名|吸納對手去減少競爭|確保投入供應穩定|將風險分散喺唔同產品上
hint_en: Would the motive still make sense for a firm that expands in a totally different direction?
hint_zh: 如果間 firm 向完全唔同方向擴充，個動機仲通唔通？
explain_en: Scale, resource use and the brand name follow from being larger in any direction. Reducing competition, securing inputs and spreading risk each depend on the particular direction chosen.
explain_zh: 規模、資源運用同品牌名，向邊個方向擴充都會有。減少競爭、確保投入、分散風險，就各自取決於擴充嘅方向。

prompt_en: Put the reasoning behind vertical backward expansion in order:
prompt_zh: 將 vertical backward expansion 背後嘅推理排好次序：
items_en: The factory buys all its raw materials from an outside supplier.|The supplier delays delivery and raises its price.|Production in the factory is interrupted and costs rise.|The factory takes over the supplier so that it can supply its own inputs.
items_zh: 間廠所有原材料都向外面供應商買。|供應商延遲交貨，仲加價。|間廠嘅生產被打斷，成本上升。|間廠接管咗供應商，自己供應自己嘅投入。
hint_en: What problem has to appear before the firm wants to own its supplier?
hint_zh: 要出現咩問題，firm 先會想擁有自己嘅供應商？
explain_en: Dependence on an outside supplier creates the risk of delays and price rises, and backward expansion removes that risk by securing the firm's own supply of inputs.
explain_zh: 依賴外面供應商會有延誤同加價嘅風險，backward expansion 令 firm 自己供應投入，就消除咗呢個風險。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Standing on a Kwun Tong rooftop in 1986, Mr Lau of Wah Lee Electronics says: 'I want to make sure no one can cut off my supply of circuit boards again.' The expansion that meets his aim is:
prompt_zh: （虛構）1986 年，華利電子嘅劉生企喺觀塘天台講：「我要確保冇人再斷我嘅線路板供應。」符合佢目標嘅擴充係：
options_en: taking over another radio factory making the same sets|taking over the circuit board factory that supplies him|opening his own electrical appliance shops|buying a car park operator
options_zh: 接管另一間做同款收音機嘅工廠|接管供應線路板畀佢嘅線路板廠|自己開電器舖|買一間停車場營運商
hint_en: Are circuit boards an input to his radios, or something he sells?
hint_zh: 線路板係佢收音機嘅投入，定係佢賣嘅嘢？
explain_en: Circuit boards are an input from an earlier stage, so vertical backward expansion secures the supply. The other options do not touch his input supply.
explain_zh: 線路板係較早階段嘅投入，所以 vertical backward expansion 先可以確保供應。其他選項都唔關佢投入供應事。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Sort Mr Lau's stated reasons by the type of expansion each one points to:
prompt_zh: （虛構）將劉生講嘅理由，按各自指向嘅擴充類型分類：
options_en: horizontal expansion|vertical expansion|lateral or conglomerate expansion
options_zh: horizontal expansion|vertical expansion|lateral 或 conglomerate expansion
items_en: 'I want a bigger share of the radio market.'|'I want one fewer rival selling the same radios.'|'I want my own shops so my radios always have somewhere to be sold.'|'I want to own the factory that makes my circuit boards.'|'I want a second business so that a bad year for radios will not sink me.'
items_zh: 「我想喺收音機市場佔多啲份額。」|「我想少一個賣同款收音機嘅對手。」|「我想有自己嘅舖頭，令我啲收音機永遠有地方賣。」|「我想擁有造我線路板嗰間廠。」|「我想有第二盤生意，收音機淡年都唔會拖死我。」
hint_en: Is each reason about the same product, about a stage of the chain, or about a different product?
hint_zh: 每個理由係講同一產品、講生產鏈上嘅階段，定係講另一種產品？
explain_en: Market share and fewer rivals point to horizontal expansion; owning shops or the board factory points to vertical expansion; a second business to survive a bad year points to lateral or conglomerate expansion.
explain_zh: 市場份額同少個對手指向 horizontal；擁有舖頭或者線路板廠指向 vertical；用第二盤生意捱過淡年就指向 lateral 或 conglomerate。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Wah Lee makes 4 000 radios a month at an average cost of $90. After expanding, it makes 10 000 a month at an average cost of $72. What is the monthly saving on the 10 000 radios compared with making them at the old average cost, and which motive does this illustrate?
prompt_zh: （虛構）華利每月做 4 000 部收音機，average cost $90。擴充之後每月做 10 000 部，average cost $72。同用舊 average cost 做 10 000 部比較，每月慳幾多？呢個說明邊個動機？
options_en: $18, reducing competition|$72 000, spreading risk|$180 000, enjoying economies of scale|$900 000, securing input supply
options_zh: $18，減少競爭|$72 000，分散風險|$180 000，享受 economies of scale|$900 000，確保投入供應
hint_en: Find the cost per unit saved, then multiply by the new output.
hint_zh: 先計每單位慳咗幾多，再乘新產量？
explain_en: Average cost falls by $90 minus $72, which is $18, and $18 times 10 000 radios is $180 000 a month. A fall in average cost as scale rises is economies of scale.
explain_zh: Average cost 跌咗 $90 減 $72 即 $18，$18 乘 10 000 部等於每月 $180 000。規模上升令 average cost 下跌就係 economies of scale。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Wah Lee uses the same well known name on its new products, which is a motive ____ to all types of expansion. It also absorbs a rival radio maker, which reduces ____ in the radio market.
prompt_zh: （虛構）華利喺新產品上用返同一個響噹噹嘅名，呢個動機係所有類型擴充 ① 嘅。佢又吸納咗一個收音機對手，令收音機市場嘅 ② 減少。
options_en: common|unique|competition|output
options_zh: 共通|獨有|競爭|產量
hint_en: Which motive works in any direction, and which one needs a rival to disappear?
hint_zh: 邊個動機向邊個方向都做到？邊個要對手消失先做到？
explain_en: Use of the brand name, economies of scale and efficient use of resources are common to all types. Removing a rival only happens in external horizontal expansion.
explain_zh: 利用品牌名、economies of scale 同更有效運用資源係所有類型共通。除去對手只會喺 external horizontal expansion 出現。

prompt_en: (Fictional) A modern Hong Kong bakery chain says its expansion aims to 'spread risk so that a bad year for bread will not sink the firm'. Which move fits that aim?
prompt_zh: （虛構）一間現代香港麵包連鎖店話佢擴充嘅目標係「分散風險，令麵包淡年都唔會拖垮間 firm」。邊個行動符合呢個目標？
options_en: taking over another bakery chain|buying the flour mill that supplies it|opening twenty more bakeries of its own|buying a firm that runs language centres
options_zh: 接管另一間麵包連鎖店|買供應麵粉畀佢嘅麵粉廠|自己再開多二十間麵包舖|買一間開語言中心嘅 firm
hint_en: Which move leaves the firm depending on something other than bread?
hint_zh: 邊個行動令間 firm 唔再淨係靠麵包？
explain_en: Only moving into an unrelated product spreads risk. The first and third keep the firm in bread, and the flour mill is still part of the bread chain, so a bad year for bread still hurts.
explain_zh: 只有進入唔相關嘅產品先分散到風險。第一同第三個都仲係做麵包，麵粉廠亦都喺麵包嗰條鏈度，麵包淡年一樣受累。

prompt_en: Under perfect competition every seller sells a good that buyers regard as identical, so no seller can charge more than the market price.
prompt_zh: 喺 perfect competition 之下，每個賣家賣嘅嘢喺買家眼中都係一模一樣，所以冇一個賣家可以收貴過 market price。
hint_en: If the goods look exactly the same to buyers, why would anyone pay more at one stall?
hint_zh: 如果啲貨喺買家眼中完全一樣，點解會有人肯喺一檔俾多啲錢？
explain_en: Homogeneous goods plus perfect market information mean buyers switch stalls at once, so the market price is the only price a seller can charge.
explain_zh: Homogeneous goods 加 perfect market information，買家會即刻轉檔，所以賣家只可以收 market price。

prompt_en: A perfectly competitive market is made up of a small number of large sellers.
prompt_zh: Perfect competition 嘅市場係由少數大賣家組成。
hint_en: How big is one seller compared with the whole market?
hint_zh: 一個賣家同成個市場比，佔幾大？
explain_en: Perfect competition requires very many small sellers, each supplying only a tiny share of total market output.
explain_zh: Perfect competition 要求有非常多細賣家，每個只佔市場總產量好細嘅一份。

prompt_en: Perfect competition can be found in many street markets in Hong Kong today.
prompt_zh: 今日香港好多街市都搵到 perfect competition。
hint_en: Do all four conditions ever hold completely at the same time?
hint_zh: 四個條件有冇試過完全同時成立？
explain_en: Perfect competition does not exist in the real world; markets such as the goldfish stalls only approximate it because the four conditions are never fully met.
explain_zh: Perfect competition 喺現實世界唔存在；好似金魚街嘅檔口只係接近，因為四個條件從來唔會完全滿足。

prompt_en: Which of the following is NOT a condition of perfect competition?
prompt_zh: 以下邊一項唔係 perfect competition 嘅條件？
options_en: very many small sellers|homogeneous goods|free entry into and exit from the market|each seller advertises heavily to build its own brand
options_zh: 非常多細賣家|homogeneous goods|自由進出市場|每個賣家落重本賣廣告去建立自己品牌
hint_en: Would a seller bother to advertise if every stall sells exactly the same thing at the same price?
hint_zh: 如果每檔賣嘅嘢同價錢都一模一樣，賣家使唔使賣廣告？
explain_en: The four conditions are very many small sellers, homogeneous goods, free entry and exit, and perfect market information. Brand building belongs to differentiated goods, not to perfect competition.
explain_zh: 四個條件係非常多細賣家、homogeneous goods、自由進出、perfect market information。建立品牌係 differentiated goods 先有，唔屬於 perfect competition。

prompt_en: A seller under perfect competition is a price taker because:
prompt_zh: Perfect competition 之下嘅賣家係 price taker，因為：
options_en: the government fixes the price of the good|his output is so small relative to the whole market that he cannot affect the market price|all the sellers have signed a price agreement|he sells a differentiated good
options_zh: 政府規定咗件貨嘅價錢|佢嘅產量相對成個市場太細，影響唔到 market price|所有賣家簽咗價格協議|佢賣嘅係 differentiated good
hint_en: What happens to the market price if one tiny stall doubles or stops its output?
hint_zh: 如果一檔細檔口產量加倍或者收檔，market price 會有咩變化？
explain_en: A price taker must accept the market price because his own quantity is too small a share of the market to move it.
explain_zh: Price taker 一定要接受 market price，因為佢自己嘅數量佔市場太細，郁唔到個價。

prompt_en: Perfect market information in a perfectly competitive market means that:
prompt_zh: Perfect competition 市場入面嘅 perfect market information 即係：
options_en: every seller must publish his accounts|buyers and sellers all know the prices being charged and the quality of the goods on offer|the government collects and announces the market data|buyers can predict next year's price with certainty
options_zh: 每個賣家要公開自己盤數|買家同賣家都知道各處嘅價錢同貨品質素|政府收集同公布市場數據|買家可以肯定咁預測下年嘅價錢
hint_en: What must a buyer know before he can walk away from an overpriced stall?
hint_zh: 買家要知道啲咩，先可以掉頭走去第二檔？
explain_en: Perfect market information means the prices and quality on offer are known to everyone in the market; it is not about published accounts or forecasting the future.
explain_zh: Perfect market information 即係市場上嘅價錢同質素人人都知，唔係指公開盤數或者預測未來。

prompt_en: In a perfectly competitive goldfish market, a stall that raises its price above the market price will:
prompt_zh: 喺一個 perfect competition 嘅金魚市場，有檔口將價錢抬高過 market price，佢會：
options_en: sell nothing at all|sell slightly less than before|sell exactly the same quantity|force the other stalls to raise their prices too
options_zh: 一條都賣唔出|賣少少過之前|賣到完全一樣嘅數量|逼到其他檔口都要加價
hint_en: Where will the buyers go when the goods are identical and every price is known?
hint_zh: 當啲貨一模一樣、每個價錢大家都知，買家會去邊？
explain_en: With homogeneous goods and perfect information, buyers move to another stall at the market price, so the quantity demanded at the higher price is zero.
explain_zh: 貨品 homogeneous 加上資訊完全，買家會轉去另一檔用 market price 買，所以抬價之後 quantity demanded 係零。

prompt_en: Under perfect competition there are very many small sellers selling ____ goods, and there is ____ entry into and exit from the market.
prompt_zh: 喺 perfect competition 之下，有非常多細賣家賣緊 ① 嘅貨品，而且可以 ② 咁進出市場。
options_en: homogeneous|differentiated|free|restricted
options_zh: homogeneous|differentiated|自由|受限制
hint_en: Are the goods identical or different, and can a new seller just join?
hint_zh: 啲貨係一樣定唔同？新賣家可唔可以話入就入？
explain_en: Homogeneous goods and free entry and exit are two of the four conditions; differentiated goods belong to monopolistic competition and restricted entry to oligopoly and monopoly.
explain_zh: Homogeneous goods 同自由進出係四個條件其中兩個；differentiated goods 係 monopolistic competition 嘅特徵，進入受限制就係 oligopoly 同 monopoly。

prompt_en: Because each seller supplies only a tiny share of the market, he must accept the market price and is called a ____; perfect competition is a ____ model that does not exist in the real world.
prompt_zh: 因為每個賣家只供應市場好細嘅一份，佢一定要接受 market price，所以叫做 ①；perfect competition 係一個 ② 模型，現實世界唔存在。
options_en: price taker|price searcher|theoretical|legal
options_zh: price taker|price searcher|理論|法律
hint_en: Can the seller choose his own price, and have you ever seen all four conditions hold at once?
hint_zh: 賣家可唔可以自己揀價？你又見過四個條件同時成立未？
explain_en: Every seller in perfect competition is a price taker, and the model is a theoretical benchmark: real markets such as the goldfish stalls only approximate it.
explain_zh: Perfect competition 入面每個賣家都係 price taker，而個模型只係一個理論標準：好似金魚街咁嘅真實市場只係接近佢。

prompt_en: Sort each feature by whether perfect competition requires it:
prompt_zh: 將以下特徵按 perfect competition 需唔需要嚟分類：
options_en: required by perfect competition|not a feature of perfect competition
options_zh: perfect competition 需要|唔係 perfect competition 嘅特徵
items_en: homogeneous goods|each seller advertises his own brand name|very many small sellers|free entry into and exit from the market|high entry barriers|buyers know every price being charged
items_zh: homogeneous goods|每個賣家賣廣告推自己品牌|非常多細賣家|自由進出市場|高入場門檻|買家知道所有人收緊咩價
hint_en: Check the feature against the four conditions one by one.
hint_zh: 逐個對返四個條件嚟睇吓？
explain_en: The four conditions are very many small sellers, homogeneous goods, free entry and exit, and perfect market information; branding and entry barriers contradict them.
explain_zh: 四個條件係非常多細賣家、homogeneous goods、自由進出、perfect market information；搞品牌同高門檻同佢哋相反。

prompt_en: Sort each Mong Kok market by how close it is to perfect competition:
prompt_zh: 將以下旺角市場按有幾接近 perfect competition 分類：
options_en: close to perfect competition|far from perfect competition
options_zh: 接近 perfect competition|離 perfect competition 好遠
items_en: dozens of stalls on the goldfish street all selling the same common goldfish at the same price|the only supplier of piped water in the whole district|a stall selling T-shirts printed with its own design and label|many small stalls selling identical plain plastic fish bags|three large firms supplying almost all the aquarium pumps in the city
items_zh: 金魚街幾十檔全部賣同一種普通金魚、同一個價|成區唯一嘅自來水供應商|一檔賣自己設計同貼自己招紙嘅 T 恤|好多細檔賣完全一樣嘅普通膠魚袋|三間大公司供應全市差唔多所有魚缸泵
hint_en: Are the goods identical, and how many sellers are there?
hint_zh: 啲貨係咪一模一樣？又有幾多個賣家？
explain_en: Many small sellers of identical goods approximate perfect competition; a single supplier, a branded product or a few dominant firms each break one of the conditions.
explain_zh: 好多細賣家賣一模一樣嘅貨就接近 perfect competition；單一供應商、有品牌嘅貨、或者幾間大公司主導，各自打破咗其中一個條件。

prompt_en: Put in order what free entry does to an unusually high profit on the goldfish street:
prompt_zh: 排出自由進入市場點樣影響金魚街嘅超高利潤：
items_en: the existing goldfish stalls are earning an unusually high profit|new sellers are free to enter the market|the market supply increases|the market price falls|the unusually high profit disappears
items_zh: 現有金魚檔賺緊超高利潤|新賣家可以自由進入市場|市場供應增加|market price 下跌|超高利潤消失
hint_en: What attracts new sellers, and what do extra sellers do to supply and price?
hint_zh: 係咩吸引新賣家入嚟？多咗賣家之後供應同價錢會點？
explain_en: Free entry is the condition that stops high profit lasting: entry raises supply, supply pushes the price down, and the profit is competed away.
explain_zh: 自由進入就係令超高利潤留唔耐嘅條件：有人入場令供應增加，供應推低價錢，利潤就被競爭蠶食。

prompt_en: (Fictional) On the goldfish street there are 60 small stalls, all selling exactly the same kind of common goldfish at $8 each, and every buyer can see every price. Ah Ming puts his price up to $10 while the other 59 stalls stay at $8. What will happen to Ah Ming?
prompt_zh: （虛構）金魚街有 60 檔細檔，全部賣同一種普通金魚，每條 $8，而且買家見到晒所有價錢。阿明將自己個價抬到 $10，其餘 59 檔維持 $8。阿明會點？
options_en: he will sell a little less than before|he will sell nothing, because buyers simply move to the stalls charging $8|the other stalls will follow him to $10|he will sell the same quantity because buyers are loyal
options_zh: 佢會賣少少過之前|佢一條都賣唔出，因為買家直接行去 $8 嗰啲檔|其他檔會跟住抬到 $10|佢會賣到一樣多，因為啲買家好忠心
hint_en: With identical fish and known prices, what is the cost to a buyer of walking to the next stall?
hint_zh: 啲魚一模一樣、價錢又人人知，買家行去隔籬檔嘅代價係幾多？
explain_en: A price taker cannot sell above the market price: homogeneous goods and perfect information make the quantity demanded at $10 zero.
explain_zh: Price taker 唔可以賣貴過 market price：貨品 homogeneous 加資訊完全，$10 嘅 quantity demanded 就係零。

prompt_en: (Fictional) The goldfish street sells 60,000 common goldfish a week in total, and Ah Fan's stall sells 300 of them. Ah Fan's share of the market is ____ per cent, which is why he is a ____ and must accept the market price.
prompt_zh: （虛構）金魚街一星期總共賣出 60,000 條普通金魚，阿芬檔賣咗其中 300 條。阿芬佔市場 ① 個百分比，所以佢係一個 ②，一定要接受 market price。
options_en: 0.5|5|price taker|price searcher
options_zh: 0.5|5|price taker|price searcher
hint_en: Divide his sales by the market total first, then ask how much power that share gives him.
hint_zh: 先用佢嘅銷量除市場總數，再諗吓咁細嘅份額有幾多話事權？
explain_en: 300 divided by 60,000 is 0.005, that is 0.5 per cent; such a tiny share cannot move the market price, so the seller is a price taker.
explain_zh: 300 除以 60,000 等於 0.005，即 0.5%；咁細嘅份額郁唔到 market price，所以個賣家係 price taker。

prompt_en: (Fictional) Sort each practice on a fictional goldfish street by whether it fits perfect competition:
prompt_zh: （虛構）將虛構金魚街上嘅以下做法，按符唔符合 perfect competition 分類：
options_en: fits perfect competition|breaks a condition of perfect competition
options_zh: 符合 perfect competition|違反 perfect competition 嘅條件
items_en: every stall sells the same common goldfish with no label or packaging|a new seller opens a stall next month with no licence problem|one stall gives its fish a brand name and a printed box|the ten biggest stalls agree to keep the price at $9|a price list is posted at every stall so buyers can compare
items_zh: 每檔都賣同一種普通金魚，冇招紙冇包裝|下個月有新賣家開檔，牌照冇問題|有檔將啲魚改咗個品牌名，仲用印刷紙盒|十間最大嘅檔口夾埋將價錢維持喺 $9|每檔都貼咗價錢牌俾買家比較
hint_en: Does the practice keep the goods identical and the market open, or does it not?
hint_zh: 呢個做法有冇令啲貨保持一模一樣、市場保持開放？
explain_en: Branding creates differentiated goods and an agreement on price removes the independent price taking, so both break the model; identical goods, easy entry and open prices fit it.
explain_zh: 搞品牌會製造 differentiated goods，夾價又令賣家唔再獨立地做 price taker，兩樣都破壞咗個模型；貨品一樣、入場容易、價錢公開就符合。

prompt_en: (Fictional) The market price of a common goldfish on the fictional goldfish street is $8, and Ah Keung's stall can sell its whole daily stock at that price. Why does Ah Keung not cut his price to $7 to attract more buyers?
prompt_zh: （虛構）虛構金魚街普通金魚嘅 market price 係 $8，強哥檔每日啲貨用呢個價都賣得晒。點解強哥唔減到 $7 嚟搶客？
options_en: cutting the price is against the law|the other stalls would sue him|he can already sell his whole stock at $8, so a lower price only reduces his revenue|buyers would think his fish are better
options_zh: 減價犯法|其他檔會告佢|佢用 $8 已經賣得晒，減價只會令收入減少|買家會以為佢啲魚好啲
hint_en: If everything is already sold at $8, what extra quantity can $7 possibly bring?
hint_zh: 如果 $8 已經賣晒，$7 仲可以多賣幾多？
explain_en: A price taker faces the market price for as much as he can supply, so cutting the price adds no quantity and simply lowers revenue per fish.
explain_zh: Price taker 喺 market price 之下想賣幾多都賣到，所以減價唔會多賣，淨係令每條魚嘅收入跌。

prompt_en: (Fictional) A teacher says the fictional goldfish street is a real-life example of a perfectly competitive market. This statement is exactly correct.
prompt_zh: （虛構）有老師話虛構金魚街就係現實中 perfect competition 嘅例子。呢句話完全正確。
hint_en: Is the market information there really perfect, and are the fish really identical?
hint_zh: 嗰度嘅 market information 真係完全咩？啲魚又真係一模一樣咩？
explain_en: Perfect competition does not exist in the real world; the goldfish street only approximates it because information is not perfect and the fish are not exactly identical.
explain_zh: Perfect competition 喺現實世界唔存在；金魚街只係接近，因為資訊唔係完全，啲魚亦都唔係一模一樣。

prompt_en: Under monopolistic competition the goods sold by different sellers are differentiated in the eyes of buyers.
prompt_zh: 喺 monopolistic competition 之下，唔同賣家賣嘅貨喺買家眼中係 differentiated。
hint_en: Do buyers think the bag from this stall is exactly the same as the one next door?
hint_zh: 買家會唔會覺得呢檔嘅袋同隔籬檔嗰個完全一樣？
explain_en: Differentiated goods are the defining feature that separates monopolistic competition from perfect competition, where goods are homogeneous.
explain_zh: Differentiated goods 就係分開 monopolistic competition 同 perfect competition 嘅關鍵特徵，後者啲貨係 homogeneous。

prompt_en: A seller under monopolistic competition who raises his price loses every one of his customers at once.
prompt_zh: 喺 monopolistic competition 之下嘅賣家一加價，就會即刻走晒所有客。
hint_en: If some buyers really like this stall's own design, will they all leave over a few dollars?
